item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 04/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southwesterly airstream will bring showers to the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. It will still be very hot over the region. Meanwhile, an area of low pressure will linger over Beibu Wan and the coast of Guangxi, and bring unsettled weather to the region. With the strengthening of the anticyclone aloft over the northern part of the South China Sea, showers will lessen over the coast of southern China midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Khanun will move across the Ryukyu Islands in the next couple of days, and gradually edge closer to the vicinity of the western part of Honshu and Kyushu of Japan afterwards.
